data.gender_notes: Marqooma is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'r-q-m' which means to be martyred, to die for a cause. Marqooma is a name given to a mother who has lost her child in the way of Allah. This name holds great significance in Islamic culture as it signifies sacrifice, courage, and devotion to one's faith. The name Marqooma carries the meaning “Mother of the martyrs” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Marqooma usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the martyrs and live with faith, good character and purpose.
